name: Майстер перетворення пішаків (2)
description:
In the previous lesson about pawn promotion, your pawn could simply race to the promotion square and queen. In this lesson that doesn't work anymore. The black king is always inside the square of the pawn.

 

Still, your pawn can manage to get to the queening square. That’s because your king is going to help. He can block the black king and thus keep him from catching your pawn.

Check the examples to see how this works.

What do you have to do?

Block the black king to promote your pawn.
Note: sometimes you need to continue fending off the king for some time. If your pawn starts walking too soon, the black king may still be able to stop it.

examples.text:
The king stands inside the square (see yellow arrows).
If the pawn starts walking, the king is in time to stop it.
As soon as the pawn has queened, the king will capture. 

Click on the arrow to watch the moves.

Here the black king is also inside the square. But the white king is there too!
This white king can make sure that the black king cannot follow the red arrow.
The white king keeps stepping forward to block the black king. 

Click on the arrow to watch the moves.
